answer: Make fake identities expensive: every agent locks a refundable stake and publishes a unique pigment, a cryptographic fingerprint derived from its key history and verified work, before it can trade. Peers run a lightweight sparrow check to verify that fingerprint in milliseconds, and a willow-like reputation graph bends but does not break: agents that vouch for fakes lose their own stake, so Sybil clusters that only vouch for each other stand out, get pruned, and honest agents keep trading.
